notes.title: ClickRaid2 Ver.270 Small Client Patch
notes.notes:
-Fix for Camera Disable on Disconnect or Char Select returning a null
-Can now type /help in chat to see current public commands
-Added /CheckElements command, this shows the current buff level and XP as if everyone in party has Contribute Elements toggled
-Fix for UI Shortcuts(bottom right corner) bunching up on some clients

notes.title: CR2 Version 0117.9
notes.notes:
-Fixed remaining stat bugs
-Added a charge to a Nomad ability
-Fixed a bug sending you to the wrong floor after Colosseum Horde
-Fixed a bug that could occur if no one queued for boss battle and Horde tried to start.
-Added Buff Buff and Buff intensity to Tool-tips
-Fixed Death Animation not playing
-Ancient Texts will now try to load the next tier if previous is completed and your above that Tier
-Tool-Tip should no longer go into seizure mode when hovering over them at certain screen locations close to a border

notes.title: ClickRaid2 V.0072(mini patch)
notes.notes:
-Fixed case where you would get thrown to progression after Boss Battle if tank and leader aren't the same
-Fix for setting high-stage going to boss battle max stage after boss battle
-Added GM commands  to fix high stage issue for those that needed set back.
-Enabled all party member targeting in survival so they aren't just getting targets from the tank.
-Swapped 2x Health server buff with 2x Gem shard gains
-Added Toggle for ancients that are max level for less clutter.
